# Figure 6C reanalysis


## Load libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_tsv("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/data/processed/6C_distance-bins-mm10.tsv")
```
## Calculate reporter expression from two technical replicates
```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    pool = sub("_.*", "", pool_barcode),
    IR_expression = (expression_counts_1 + expression_counts_2) / (normalization_counts_1 + normalization_counts_2)
  )
```

## Summarize expression by distance bin
```{r}
# calculate median expression seperately for each mPGK pool
pool_summary <- df %>% 
  group_by(pool, distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(median_expression = median(IR_expression),
            .groups = "drop")
# calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_6C <- pool_summary %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
    sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pools = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
    
# calculate mean enhancer distance in each bin
distance_summary <- df %>% 
  group_by(distance_bin) %>% 
  summarise(mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
            n_IRs = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

# combine expression and distance summaries
summary_6C <- summary_6C %>% 
  left_join(distance_summary, by = "distance_bin") %>% 
  arrange(distance_bin)

summary_6C

# save the summary file
write_tsv(summary_6C, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_summary.tsv")

```
## Plot figure 6C
```{r}
p <- summary_6C %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_distance_kb, y = mean_expression)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
                  ymax = mean_expression + sem),
              fill = "steelblue",
              alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 1) + 
  labs(title = "Figure 6C Reanalysis",
       x = "Distance from nearest enhancer (kb)",
       y = "IR expression") +
  theme_classic()

p

# save the plot
ggsave("/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 7,
       height = 5)

```

## Focus on IRs within 50 kb of the nearest enhancer

```{r}
# select IRs within 50 kb and divide into 10 equal-count bins
df_50kb <- df %>%
  filter(distance >= 0, distance < 50000) %>%
  arrange(distance) %>%
  mutate(distance_bin_50kb = ntile(distance, 10))

# calculate median expression for each pool and distance bin
pool_summary_50kb <- df_50kb %>%
  group_by(pool, distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    median_expression = median(IR_expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate mean and SEM across pool medians
summary_50kb <- pool_summary_50kb %>%
  group_by(distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_expression = mean(median_expression),
    sem = sd(median_expression) / sqrt(n()),
    n_pools = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# calculate mean enhancer distance and number of IRs
distance_summary_50kb <- df_50kb %>%
  group_by(distance_bin_50kb) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_distance_kb = mean(distance) / 1000,
    n_IRs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# combine expression and distance summaries
summary_50kb <- summary_50kb %>%
  left_join(distance_summary_50kb, by = "distance_bin_50kb") %>%
  arrange(distance_bin_50kb)

summary_50kb

# plot the 0-50 kb region
p_50kb <- summary_50kb %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_distance_kb, y = mean_expression)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(0, mean_expression - sem),
      ymax = mean_expression + sem
    ),
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 50),
    breaks = seq(0, 50, 5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 6C Reanalysis (0–50 kb, quantile bins)",
    x = "Distance from nearest enhancer (kb)",
    y = "IR expression"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_50kb
```

save the results
```{r}
# save the summary data
write_tsv(
  summary_50kb,
  "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_50kb_quantile_summary.tsv"
)

# save the plot
ggsave(
  "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/enhancer-IR/results/figure6C_50kb_quantile.png",
  plot = p_50kb,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)
```
